title: For the one that have been praised
description: A supplication to be said when someone praises you, seeking Allah's forgiveness for what they don't know about you and protection from being judged by what others say.

duas.transliteration: Allāhumma lā tu'ākhidhnī bimā yaqūlūn, waghfir lī mā lā yaĀlamūn wa jāġalnī khayran mimmā yaẓunnūn.
duas.translation: O Allah, do not call me to account for what they say and forgive me for what they have no knowledge of and make me better than they imagine.
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لاَ تُؤَاخِذْنِي بِمَا يَقُولُونَ وَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا لاَ يَعْلَمُونَ وَاجْعَلْنِي خَيْرًا مِمَّا يَظُّنُّونَ
duas.reference: Al-Bukhari, Al-'Adabul-Mufrad no. 761. See Al-Albani, Sahih Al-'Adabul-Mufrad (no. 585). The portion with 'make me better' is from Al-Bayhaqi, Shu'ab Al-Iman 4/228.

benefits: Humility, seeking forgiveness from Allah, protection from arrogance and self-deception
